summary: Daniel Tuthill of Goshen, who died in 1761; brother of Capt. John Tuttle, John's 7th-great-grand-uncle.
bio: Daniel Tuthill, known as Daniel Tuthill of Goshen, was a brother of Capt. John Tuttle. He died at Goshen, Orange County, New York, in 1761. In his will, made that year, he asked to be buried 'decent without Pomp or State', named Joshua Brown as his executor, and had John Brewster, Samuel Smith and Selah Strong as witnesses. He should not be confused with the later Daniel Tuthill (1743-1800) who served in the Revolution.
sources: Abstracts of Wills, NYHS vol. VI, Liber 23 p. 130, https://archive.org/details/abstractswillso05kellgoog
